title: Record main-session tokens and effort per trial
item: Record the main session's token use and effort level in every trial
motivation: Trial cost counts only subagent tokens, so $3.42–4.06 per trial is an undercount by an unknown amount; some trials recorded effort as unknown
notes: A change to the measuring setup; its own commit. Check what the Claude Code harness exposes before promising exact numbers.
done_means: Every trial.json holds the main session's token use and effort level, or the README states what Claude Code does not expose.
